title: The Slow Color Shift Homeowners Overlook
content: Homeowners investing in resin-based countertops, floors, and accent surfaces often expect a permanent, glass-like finish. Over time, though, many notice a subtle shift: a once-clear coating develops a faint amber or yellow tone. This change surprises people who assume any discoloration signals a flaw in installation or materials, when it reflects a well-documented characteristic of […]
